---
title: "Community dynamics: six-panel review"
format: html
editor: source
---

Display-only preview from the six previously selected MAG/vOTU trajectories.
No model refits or live manuscript renumbering. Run chunks inline or use
`bash scripts/run_qmd.sh analysis/figure2_community_dynamics.qmd NEW_OUTPUT_DIR`.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table);library(ggplot2);library(patchwork)})
out <- commandArgs(TRUE)[1]
stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
root <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
paths <- c(trajectories=file.path(root,"figure1_expanded_2026-09-14-v2/tables/selected_trajectories.tsv"),
 labels=file.path(root,"figure1_expanded_2026-09-14-v2/tables/trajectory_labels_and_colours.tsv"))
hash <- function(p) digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256")
before <- vapply(paths,hash,character(1))
d <- fread(paths[1]); labels <- fread(paths[2])
stopifnot(nrow(labels)==6, uniqueN(d$feature_id)==6, nrow(d)==72,
 all(d[, .N, by=feature_id]$N==12), all(is.finite(d$normalized_count)),
 all(d$normalized_count>=0),all(labels$main_q<.05 | labels$interaction_q<.05))
dir.create(file.path(out,"figures"),recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(out,"tables"))
d[,condition:=factor(condition,levels=c("control","treatment"),labels=c("Control","Treatment"))]
d[,phase:=factor(phase,levels=c("initial","backflush"),labels=c("Initial","Backflush"))]
qtext <- function(x) if(x<.001) formatC(x,format="e",digits=1) else formatC(x,format="g",digits=2)
count_label <- function(x) vapply(x,function(v) if(is.na(v)) NA_character_ else if(v>=999999) paste0(format(signif(v/1e6,2),trim=TRUE),"M") else if(v>=999) paste0(format(signif(v/1e3,2),trim=TRUE),"K") else format(signif(v,2),trim=TRUE),character(1))
panel <- function(id) {
 x <- d[feature_id==id]; k <- labels[feature_id==id]
 short <- if(k$community=="MAGs") sub("_MAGScoT_cleanbin_0*","/",id) else sub("_coassembly_megahit_.*_contig_k141_","/",id)
 name <- if(k$community=="MAGs") paste(gsub("\\*","",sub("^.__","",k$taxonomy)),short) else paste("Caudoviricetes",short)
 ggplot(x,aes(cycle,normalized_count,colour=condition,shape=phase,linetype=phase,group=interaction(condition,phase)))+
 geom_line(linewidth=.55)+geom_point(size=2,stroke=.3)+
 scale_colour_manual(values=c(Control="#8FCB8A",Treatment="#7E57C2"),drop=FALSE)+
 scale_shape_manual(values=c(Initial=16,Backflush=17),drop=FALSE)+
 scale_linetype_manual(values=c(Initial="solid",Backflush="dashed"),drop=FALSE)+
 scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:3,limits=c(.85,3.15))+
 scale_y_continuous(trans=scales::pseudo_log_trans(base=10),breaks=scales::breaks_log(n=4),
 labels=count_label,expand=expansion(mult=c(.09,.13)))+
 labs(title=name,subtitle=paste0("Condition FDR (BH) = ",qtext(k$main_q),"; cycle interaction FDR (BH) = ",qtext(k$interaction_q)),
 x="Cleaning cycle",y="Normalized counts",colour=NULL,shape=NULL,linetype=NULL)+
 theme_classic(base_size=8)+theme(plot.title=element_text(size=9,face="plain"),
 plot.subtitle=element_text(size=7,margin=margin(b=5)),axis.text=element_text(size=8),
 plot.margin=margin(7,9,7,7),legend.position="bottom",legend.text=element_text(size=8),
 plot.tag=element_text(size=11,face="bold"))
}
p <- wrap_plots(lapply(labels$feature_id,panel),ncol=2,guides="collect")+
 plot_annotation(tag_levels="A") & theme(legend.position="bottom")
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/figure2-community-dynamics.pdf"),p,width=190,height=220,units="mm",device="pdf",useDingbats=FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/preview.png"),p,width=190,height=220,units="mm",dpi=180,bg="white")
fwrite(d,file.path(out,"tables/plotted_trajectories.tsv"),sep="\t")
file.copy(paths[2],file.path(out,"tables/trajectory_labels_and_colours.tsv"))
stopifnot(identical(before,vapply(paths,hash,character(1))))
fwrite(data.table(path=paths,sha256=before),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(c("Figure 2: Community abundance changes across cleaning cycles.",
"A-B) Normalized metagenomic counts for Rectinemataceae CI3/27 and Bacteriovoracaceae CI3/45. C-F) Counts for four Caudoviricetes vOTUs.",
"The six features passed FDR (BH) ≤ 0.05 in either the condition test or the joint condition-by-cycle interaction test. Both FDR (BH) values are shown for each feature. DESeq2 models used phase + cycle + condition for the condition test and phase + cycle * condition for the interaction test, with cycle treated categorically (Love et al., 2014; doi:10.1186/s13059-014-0550-8). Axes use feature-specific pseudo-logarithmic scales; counts were normalized separately for the MAG and vOTU communities."),file.path(out,"FIGURE_CAPTION.txt"))
writeLines("PASS: six features, 72 observations, 12 observations per feature; frozen source hashes unchanged. Display-only. Main manuscript numbering unchanged.",file.path(out,"VALIDATION.txt"))
file.copy(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH","analysis/figure2_community_dynamics.qmd"),file.path(out,"figure2_community_dynamics.qmd"))
```
